Class DissolveShader

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.effects.DissolveShader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Shader
public final class DissolveShader extends Object implements Shader
A dissolve effect that randomly dissolves text characters over time.

    • process

      public TFxDuration process(TFxDuration duration, Buffer buffer, Rect area)
      Description copied from interface: Shader
      Processes the shader for the given duration.

      The default implementation: 1. Updates the timer with the given duration (if a timer exists) 2. Calls Shader.execute(TFxDuration, Rect, Buffer) with the current state 3. Returns any overflow duration

      Most effects should use this default implementation and implement Shader.execute(TFxDuration, Rect, Buffer) instead. Only override this if you need custom timer handling.

      Specified by:
      process in interface Shader
      Parameters:
      duration - The duration to process the shader for
      buffer - The buffer where the shader will be applied
      area - The rectangular area within the buffer where the shader will be applied
      Returns:
      The overflow duration if the shader is done, or null if still running

    • execute

      public void execute(TFxDuration duration, Rect area, Buffer buffer)
      Description copied from interface: Shader
      Executes the shader effect after the duration has been applied to the timer.

      This is the main implementation point for most effects, and is called by the default Shader.process(TFxDuration, Buffer, Rect) implementation.
